sources.title: Wan2.1-T2V-14B · Models
sources.snippet: Wan2.1 is designed using the Flow Matching framework within the paradigm of mainstream Diffusion Transformers. Our model's architecture uses the T5 Encoder to encode multilingual text input, with cross-attention in each transformer block embedding the text into the model structure.

sources.title: Wan2.1-T2V-14B: Text-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Wan2.1-T2V-14B is a text-to-video diffusion transformer developed by Wan-AI that generates videos from text prompts at both 480P and 720P resolutions. The model contains 14 billion parameters and uses a diffusion transformer architecture paired with a novel 3D causal VAE called Wan-VAE for spatio-temporal compression.
